entities.summary: The Gazi Hasan Pasha Mosque, referred to locally as the Loggia Mosque, is a former mosque, located in the town and island of Kos, in the South Aegean region of Greece. Completed in c. 1777 or 1786, during the Ottoman era, the former mosque is longer open for worship. The former mosque is situated next to the legendary Tree of Hippocrates.
